title: ConstantSubsheafQuotientSection
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\iota:K\to C$ a monomorphism of abelian sheaves, and $\alpha:C\simeq\underline{\mathbb Z}$ an isomorphism to the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $n,b\in\mathbb N$, opens $A_i$, labels $0<c_i\leq b+1$, and an epimorphism $g:\bigoplus_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)}j_{A_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}\to K$ [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Assume the image of the canonical unit section under each component is $s_i\in K(A_i)$ and maps under $\alpha\iota$ to the constant section $c_i$. Define $f$ to be the coproduct map with component $g_i$ when $c_i\leq b$ and zero otherwise. Put $L=\operatorname{im}(f)$ and $l:L\to K$ its canonical inclusion, $U=\bigcup_i A_i$ and $V=\bigcup_{c_i\leq b}A_i$. Suppose $\operatorname{coker}(l)_x=0$ on $V$ and $L_x=0$ outside $V$, with stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then there exists $q:j_{U!}\underline{\mathbb Z}\to\operatorname{coker}(l)$ whose stalk map is an isomorphism at each point of $U\setminus V$. No compactness or attained-divisor hypothesis is needed here.

proof.text: Apply constantSubsheaf_quotient_gluing to Q=cokernel(l) and pi=cokernel.π(l), using the zero-stalk hypothesis on V. Obtain q and its values on top-labelled unit sections.

Apply constantSubsheaf_quotient_stalk_iso to this q and its section-value equations, the original epimorphic presentation and the hypothesis that L has zero stalks outside V. This gives the required stalk isomorphisms on U minus V; pair them with q.
